text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I finish escorting <chrname>
back to
the dorms after training when all
of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur... Murmur...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Just a smidgeon of info will do! Please
allow us to
corroborate this story!
choice_data_list: (Is that noise coming from the sch...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm very sorry, but no! You're
inconveniencing our students, so I'd
appreciate it if you would
leave the
area!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?! Oh no, you mustn't make an

appearance!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that the trainer in question?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Would you happen to be
Trainer

<username>?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are the rumors true?! Are you forcing
your trainee
to undergo brutal training?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
They say you make her run late into the
night every day, or make her sit atop a
stone for three days straight, or make
her do laps while
handstand walking.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But there's already been a news story
published
about it!
choice_data_list: T-There is absolutely no truth to ...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This whole time, I've been trying to tell
you all
that that article is nothing but
libel!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
So you claim that it's all untrue? This
matter
concerns the very reputation of
Tracen Academy
itself!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Restraint! I call for restraint!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: First, allow me to reject those claims! Categorically! Nobody at this academy would ever subject our beloved students to such suffering!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! The academy will make an
official
declaration regarding this matter
in due course!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
All members of the media, I beseech
you! Please
be patient for the time
being!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. But next time you must
grant us an
interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, Director Akikawa's words
manage to
convince the openly
discontent reporters to
leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We later hold a meeting in the director's
office
regarding the issue. According to
Reporter
Otonashi...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Essentially, our focus on gaining the 
cooperation of as many media outlets as
possible
caused our quality control to
lag behind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And now, owing to that fabricated
article making the rounds, Trainer 
<username>'s
reputation has
been cast into doubt.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Forgiveness! It is not your responsibility
alone,
Miss Otonashi!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The real culprit is the
individual who
wrote that strange article
in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It won't be easy to rein matters
in again,
given how far the situation has
escalated.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once a misunderstanding gets out there,
there's
almost no way to quash it for
good...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. But from the academy's
perspective, it's
imperative that we
ensure the safety of our
students!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, it may be best to
temporarily
suspend the media's access
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Please wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: There are no excuses for this incident. I allowed things to get out of hand!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But we simply can't make the Twinkle
Star Climax
happen without your
cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We don't intend to cut ties with the event
completely, of course! But we
must scale down news coverage until
public sentiment settles
down.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Until things settle down? You mean
when the
event's been completely
forgotten by everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the reporter and media outlet 
responsible for that libelous article will
no longer
have any involvement with the
races!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm aware that this is a selfish request!
But would
you please allow news
coverage to continue as
normal?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I don't want this incident to be a damper
on the
hype surrounding the Twinkle
Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: This race is for all Umamusume who possess the skills worthy of being dubbed the "greatest."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A chance for all those talented runners
who, by some cruel twist of fate, let that
highest honor
slip by to claim what is
rightfully theirs!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Their moment of victory deserves to be glorious! I want the atmosphere to be positively intoxicating!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'll take responsibility for this
situation and do
everything in my power to get it
under control. So
please!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Misgivings! How exactly do you intend
to resolve
the situation, Miss Otonashi?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your passion is evident. However! As
director of this academy, I am not in a
position to make
concessions on the
grounds of passion alone!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...Please allow me to conduct a report.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A report? Hmm, perplexing... We're
planning to
limit all news coverage, and
you're asking to write
a report?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It will be called "Up Close and Personal
with
Trainer
<username>"!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By following you every day, I'll be
able to
show the world your amazing
training methods.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
My report will prove that any claims of
you
conducting reckless training sessions
are
completely unfounded!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And it could double as a publicity piece!
You've
really thought this through... I am
all for it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I suppose if it's her conducting the
report, then it
shouldn't place too much
of a burden on you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But aren't you awfully busy preparing for
the
event, Reporter Otonashi?
choice_data_list: That's true... With that much know...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What happens if you need to pull out
before your
report's finished, and
someone else has to replace
you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be handling this entire
report myself, no matter what. Even if I
break every bone in my body and have
to crawl on my
stomach!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This will be my way of taking
responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I do hope you'll go to the hospital if
that
comes
to pass... What do you think,
Director?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Naturally, as head of Tracen
Academy, I
will bear responsibility for
the outcome...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Query! I'd like to hear your opinion,
Trainer
<username>.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am of the firm belief that the final
decision
should rest with you,
<chrname>'s
partner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm suddenly at a loss for words. A stable
training environment or public
support—which would be
best for
<chrname>'s development?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Reporter Otonashi's
knowledge will
be a powerful asset. But
can I really trust her?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Please... Allow me to chase my dream for
a little
while longer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! Today marks the
beginning of my
coverage on you. I
appreciate your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm actually a little
surprised that
you gave the okay.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hm? Dream, you say?
choice_data_list: Because I didn't want to close the...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
R-right!
I'll do my best not to get in your
way!
choice_data_list: No problem. I look forward to work...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not sure what Reporter
Otonashi's dream
is, but if I were to
deny her the opportunity to
pursue it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'd also be turning my back on
the
dream that <chrname>
and I vowed to
realize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins Reporter Otonashi's "up
close and
personal" coverage!
